1. [dahlquist-1963] 1963: A special stability problem for linear multistep methods. Defines absolute stability through the test equation u' = lambda u: a method is A-stable when its numerical solution decays for every lambda in the left half-plane, and no explicit method and no linear multistep method of order above two can be A-stable. Results: absolute stability on the test equation; A-stability and the second Dahlquist barrier
